_about: Public-domain John Jortin (1698-1770), Archdeacon of London, ecclesiastical historian, for the Word Hoard: his Sermons on Different Subjects (London 1787, seven volumes), Remarks on Ecclesiastical History (1805, three volumes), Tracts Philological, Critical and Miscellaneous (1790, two volumes) and the Life of Erasmus (1808, three volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 43 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
